cases.packet: Game already passes 258/258 tests and has fast-check property tests. Three disposable source mutants are injected: spare-parts boundary is killed, world-revision +1→+2 is killed, but exact battery boundary <→<= survives. An explicit boundary regression then kills the surviving mutant and the full suite remains green. Automated Stryker acquisition is currently blocked; manual disposable mutation is sufficient to expose the real blind spot.

Web already owns Chromium Playwright, Axe, browser-review trajectories, static budgets and publication/design validation. No current compatibility failure/claim requires another engine. Firefox/WebKit provisioning stalls on external browser-download supply and is cancelled rather than becoming a background mutation. No product failure attributable to missing Firefox/WebKit is observed.

The machine already has tcpdump capture capability. The missing burden is deterministic projection of immutable packet bytes into structured protocol facts. TShark decodes a fixed PCAPNG into exact HTTP request fields and later repeats the same structured decode from a signed isolated toolroot. Capture authority/evidence bytes remain separate from the decode projection.

A local HTTP origin is successfully recorded and replayed through mitmproxy, including from a signed isolated root. It provides distinct application-layer flow record/replay and programmable delay/duplication pressure useful for fault experiments. Its isolated closure is 49 Python packages / about 92 MiB, materially larger than simpler packet/surface tools; real Finance credentials should not pass through it by default.

Semgrep acquisition is unavailable on the current Python supply path. Existing substrate already includes ast-grep, Ruff, Trivy, OSV-Scanner, Syft, Cosign, Gitleaks and language-native tests. This round produces no incremental Semgrep finding or surviving SAST class that the existing stack misses.

Finance pinned Python 3.12 environment cannot currently admit Hypothesis without authority/runtime drift, so the dependency is not installed there. The property-generation method is nevertheless tested in an isolated system-Python tool environment against pure Finance normalizers: 250 generated normalize_fill examples plus 80 timestamp-fallback examples, all 330 satisfying declared invariants. The useful falsifier method is separable from the named dependency/environment.

A signed 31-package isolated osquery root materializes correctly and osqueryi --version launches, but a real system_info query aborts with free(): invalid pointer. Existing workstation doctor/status already owns the needed host semantics. The experiment establishes that generic package materialization is not universal ABI/kernel isolation; the temporary root is removed.

Across Nmap, TShark and Hypothesis experiments, the global package database is legitimately occupied by unrelated work. Repeated ad-hoc need converges on signed read-only closure resolution → package/signature verification → isolated extraction → exact executable → expiry/removal. The candidate avoids pacman/PATH mutation, binds exact package closure/task/purpose/expiry, survives signed Nmap/TShark/mitmproxy live dogfood, fixes two publication/location defects before acceptance, adds bounded list/status/gc, and explicitly fails closed for host-coupled osquery rather than claiming universal ABI isolation.

decisionOptions.CONDITIONAL: Retain only for a specific admitted experiment/use case because value exists but recurring closure/coupling cost is material.
decisionOptions.DEFER: Do not retain/admit now; reopen on a concrete future consumer/failure/coverage gap.
decisionOptions.PROMOTE_OWNER_UTILITY: Promote the smallest owner-local reusable utility because repeated real workloads demonstrate a distinct owner responsibility and live fail-closed acceptance.
decisionOptions.REJECT: Current evidence argues against this candidate/mechanism for the claimed use; no current admission.
decisionOptions.RETAIN_METHOD: Retain the method/procedure as useful; do not require the named engine/dependency as a default production dependency.
decisionOptions.RETAIN_ON_DEMAND: Retain the tool as bounded explicit on-demand equipment with narrow scope/deadline; not default/global authority.
